description: This file contains the internal implementation of the SiloMetadataCache class, which manages the caching of silo metadata in a distributed Orleans cluster, including lifecycle participation, processing membership updates, and metadata retrieval.

classes.name: SiloMetadataCache
classes.description: An internal cache class for storing and updating silo metadata within an Orleans cluster. Implements lifecycle participation, periodic membership update processing, and exposes methods to access and modify silo metadata.

methods.name: ILifecycleParticipant<ISiloLifecycle>.Participate
methods.description: Method for registering start and stop actions with the lifecycle; initiates membership update processing task on start and cancels it on stop.

methods.name: ProcessMembershipUpdates
methods.description: Asynchronous method that processes membership updates, manages cache entries for active, dead, and missing silos, and handles exceptions during polling.

methods.name: GetSiloMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves cached metadata for a given silo address, returning an empty metadata object if none exists.

methods.name: SetMetadata
methods.description: Adds or updates the metadata for a specified silo address in the cache.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Cancels ongoing membership update processing and disposes resources.
